newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent pulled off lows by NYMEX heating oil.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent pulled off lows by NYMEX heating oil.

text.p: IPE Brent retraced losses in mid-afternoon trade, aided by NYMEX heating oil which pushed up from early lows, brokers said.
Jan Brent was trading just seven cents down at $23.55 a barrel at 1621 GMT, having touched a low of $23.35.
"It's moved up again with (NYMEX) heating oil which has moved up from the open," said one broker.
Dec gas oil was trading $3.50 higher at $223.25 a tonne.
The Jan Brent/gas oil crack spread was trading at $5.98 a barrel.
Traders said speculation over the timing of Iraqi crude exports was having little effect on market moves.
"The position that we're taking is that we'll believe it when we see it," said a dealer.
An oil official in Baghdad said it was possible that Iraqi oil could hit world markets as soon as next week.
